page_title: OSA 1-3 RSO | Osasuna v Real Sociedad 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
90+5' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Real Sociedad are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90+1' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
90' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Having seen unsporting behavior, Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) is the recipient.
87' Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) will replace Carlos Soler.

82' 1 - 3 Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes under the crossbar. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
82' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
81' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes a direct free kick.
80' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
79' That's the end of the game for Flavien Boyomo, who is replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
78' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Victor Munoz will be replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
78' Substitution. Moi Gomez will be replaced by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
78' A crossfield pass from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates.
76' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot low towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
75' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Aihen Munoz and he is replaced by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
75' That will be all from Brais Mendez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
73' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Sergio Herrera.
73' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:4.
72' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' Today's match ends for Jon Moncayola who will be replaced by Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna).
71' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
67' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Remiro, who smothers the ball.
65' Osasuna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Alex Remiro anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) coming on for Juan Cruz.
60' Sergio Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replacing Arsen Zakharyan.
60' Substitution. Goncalo Guedes walks off the pitch and Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.

59' 1 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal produces a great pass that finds Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
58' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
58' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

57' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top right corner. Sergio Herrera pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
57' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
54' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Sergio Herrera. He makes it 1:1.
52' Alex Remiro displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
50' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
47' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' 1 - 0 Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:0.
42' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is about to take a corner kick.
40' CHANCE! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
39' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alex Remiro comes off the line to clear the ball away.
39' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
37' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
33' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
28' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
28' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the right post.
25' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but Sergio Herrera punches the ball away.
25' Poor challenge! Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is penalised for tripping and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle.

23' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Sergio Herrera has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
22' What a chance that is! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
21' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
20' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Sergio Herrera.
16' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
15' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
13' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
11' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle as Victor Munoz (Osasuna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

9' Osasuna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
8' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) fails to beat the offside trap. The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle.
7' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
6' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post.
5' The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
5' The ball is cleared after Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
